invocations._why: GATE.md has instructed since it was written that meta treat --self-test as this gate's second violating input, and nothing ever performed it. The byte-modification and committed-edit cases need git history that no static tree can carry, so the flag IS the fixture for them. Since rebuild-plugboard task 3.16 it also carries D31's negative half and the three empty-declaration states, which the real tree exercises only one of.
